title: Editor Paper Smooth Zoom Surface Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor agreement, prior toolbar/status context, and Backend/Core local-loopback boundaries before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-paper-smooth-zoom-surface-2026-08-29 records the exact Editor commit, live Backend mode boundary, and dependency context used for this bounded lane.
items.verificationNote: Project Control AGENTS.md, product terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, local loopback runner records, toolbar foundation records, status honesty records, and Core/Backend boundary context were read before implementation.

items.label: Define smooth zoom as viewport-only presentation, not document content, Core package truth, Backend persistence, or authoring readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-paper-smooth-zoom-surface-2026-08-29 cites the terminology and status boundary used in the UI.
items.verificationNote: The lane document defines smooth viewport zoom, viewport-only zoom, paper zoom presets, and post-transition selection overlay sync while preserving Source: Backend read and Authoring: limited honesty.

items.label: Add paper zoom controls with fixed presets and clear viewport-only labeling.
items.verificationNote: Editor commit 58f3002363b29662bb02042fdb1021236844cbc1 adds Zoom out, current zoom, presets for 50%, 85%, 100%, and 125%, and Zoom in, with the toolbar label Canvas zoom (viewport only).

items.label: Animate paper transform during viewport zoom while honoring reduced-motion users.
items.verificationNote: PaperPage marks the paper as smooth zoom motion and viewport-only, while CSS transitions transform for 160ms and disables that transition under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

items.label: Keep the selected-node overlay aligned after smooth zoom motion settles.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-paper-smooth-zoom-surface-2026-08-29 records the focused overlay regression and browser overlay measurement.
items.verificationNote: A browser check first exposed stale overlay geometry after smooth zoom; the final code schedules post-transition overlay sync, and the final browser check measured the selected title overlay within near-zero deltas after zoom settled.

items.label: Verify the rendered Editor in live Backend mode changes viewport zoom without Backend mutation requests.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-paper-smooth-zoom-surface-2026-08-29 records the worktree loopback smoke and browser zoom-path check.
items.verificationNote: The browser check opened the design route through live Backend mode, observed only Backend read/capability requests, clicked Zoom in from 85% to 95%, and found no Backend mutation request.

items.label: Keep Editor, Backend, Core, and FlowDoc broad truth states unchanged by this viewport UI lane.
items.verificationNote: The Editor Project Control Node remains truthState unknown with empty documentIds and evidenceIds.

items.label: Run RED/GREEN focused tests, full Editor gates in worktree and merged main, and bounded loopback/browser checks.
items.evidenceTarget: evidence-editor-paper-smooth-zoom-surface-2026-08-29 records focused, worktree, main, smoke, and browser verification results.
items.verificationNote: Focused RED failed for missing viewport-only zoom labels/markers and missing post-transition overlay sync, focused GREEN passed, Editor worktree npm run check passed, live Backend mode smoke/browser checks passed, and merged Editor main npm run check passed.
